title: "Ideas, experiments, and things I'm learning."
description: "I write about concepts I'm exploring, systems I'm building, and questions I find interesting. Much of my work revolves around artificial intelligence, mathematics, and computing, but my curiosity extends beyond any single field."
listing:
  # Mark one published article featured: true. Never promote fixtures or demos.
  - id: featured
    contents: posts
    include:
      featured: true
    exclude:
      draft: true
      path: "**/{welcome,post-with-code,scientific-test}/**"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 1
    template: article-preview.ejs
    fields: [title, description, date, reading-time, categories]
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
  - id: writing
    contents:
      - posts
      - "!posts/welcome/**"
      - "!posts/post-with-code/**"
    exclude:
      featured: true
      draft: true
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 5
    template: article-preview.ejs
    fields: [title, description, date, reading-time, categories]
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
  # Preserve index.xml independently of the homepage's selection and item limits.
  - id: feed
    contents: posts
    exclude:
      draft: true
    feed: true
    sort: "date desc"
    template: article-preview.ejs
    fields: [title, categories]
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
page-layout: article
title-block-banner: false
body-classes: "editorial-home editorial-page"
anchor-sections: false
---

```{=html}
<script>
// Quarto owns article selection and RSS. Turn its category labels into topic links.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const labels = new Set();
  const demoPaths = ["/posts/welcome/index.html", "/posts/post-with-code/index.html"];
  // List.js detaches rows on other pages; its items retain the complete collection.
  const feed = window["quarto-listings"]?.["listing-feed"];
  const posts = feed ? feed.items.map(item => item.elm).filter(Boolean)
    : document.querySelectorAll(".feed-source .quarto-post");
  posts.forEach(post => {
    const href = post.querySelector(".listing-title a")?.href;
    if (!href || demoPaths.some(path => new URL(href).pathname.endsWith(path))) return;
    post.querySelectorAll(".listing-category").forEach(tag => labels.add(tag.textContent.trim()));
  });
  const topicLink = label => {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    // Quarto decodes once in parseHash and again when activating the category.
    link.href = "topics.html#category=" + encodeURIComponent(encodeURIComponent(label));
    link.textContent = label;
    return link;
  };
  const topics = document.querySelector("#home-topic-links");
  [...labels].filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).slice(0, 8)
    .forEach(label => topics.append(topicLink(label)));
});
</script>
```
